valueNote: Clear conflicts on birthplace and Ballon d'Or field size, dated Concacaf and Clausura details. Unsupported Bay FC and 2023 claims removed.
summary: All claims in the revised article match the fetched sources or are stated as conflicts. The Sopitas attribution is accurate, but that source contradicts itself on the best-placed Mexican; the article attributes it.
